paragraphs: A man of Kefar Tamarta. He is mentioned at the end of chapter 6 of Esther Rabbah; Rabbi Levi reports in his name.

notes.text: The work abbreviation אס״ד is unresolved. The previous expansion “Esther Rabbah?” is withdrawn.

The saved named Torat Emet Esther Rabbah chapter 6 ends with Levi reporting in the name of Rabbi Acha bar Shila of Kefar Tamarta. This matches the notice’s place, reporting direction and end-of-chapter position. It supports that work as a content comparison alongside אס״ד, without proving the exact expansion or history of those supplied letters.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. I, p. 132) reads אס״ר where the supplied Hebrew reads אס״ד. The last passage in Esther Rabbah 6 names Rabbi Levi as reporting in the name of Rabbi Acha bar Shila of Kefar Tamarta. The earlier note reflects the supplied spelling and the evidence available at that stage.
